shortcuts.intent: Bounce the selected region(s) in place — applies all inserts on the source track and replaces the region(s) with a flattened audio file

shortcuts.intent: Toggle the Mixer panel open or closed (View → Show/Hide Mixer)

verification.question: Has the Mixer panel changed state in Logic Pro?
